column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “God is” at the start of the line.
Close to the Hebrew; “the high places of the sea” is rendered “the waves of the sea.”
NKJV translates the name רָהַב (“Rahab”) as “the proud,” giving “The allies of the proud.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who will summon me?” is rendered “who will appoint my day in court?”
Close to the Hebrew; וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי (“declare me crooked”) is rendered “prove me perverse.”
Close to the Hebrew; “ships of reed” is rendered “swift ships.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will let go my face” is rendered “I will put off my sad face.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּבֹר (“lye, potash”) is rendered “soap.”
